product_brief: Secure file sharing and transfer platform (Kiteworks Private Data Network) with FIPS 140-3 Level 1 validated encryption, on-premises or hosted.
crypto_primitives: AES-256 (at rest), TLS 1.3 (in transit), RSA 4096; key stretching, salting, hashing and message authentication algorithms
key_management_model: Customer-owned keys; each file encrypted with its own unique key; organizations can rotate keys at will; Kiteworks cannot access customer data
fips_validated: FIPS 140-3 Level 1 validated module (on-premises and hosted deployments)
target_industries: Government agencies and contractors, healthcare, financial services
regulatory_status: Supports compliance with FedRAMP, NIST 800-171, CMMC 2.0, GDPR, HIPAA, GLBA, PCI DSS (and SOX per FAQ); FIPS 140-3 Level 1 validated

evidence.FIPS Validated: Kiteworks offers a FIPS 140-3 Level 1 validated module for secure file sharing and secure file transfer, available in both on-premises and hosted deployments
evidence.Crypto Primitives: FIPS 140-3 validated solutions employ advanced encryption techniques like key stretching, salting, and robust algorithms such as AES-256 and RSA 4096
